sentences.text: Bobosaurus was a relatively large animal exceeding 3 meters in length.
The species Bobosaurus forojuliensis was named in 2006 by Fabio M. Dalla Vecchia, establishing the type species for the genus.
This creature is classified within the order Nothosauria and belongs to the unranked family Pistosauroidea.
Bobosaurus lived during the Carnian stage of the Late Triassic, between 237 and 233.6 million years ago.
Researchers debate whether Bobosaurus is a pistosaurid or closer to Plesiosauria.
